notes: Slot 8 (01:35 IST WORK, fire #8; started ~01:36 because the previous sandbox ran long). Item 13 zero-fake-success continued onto the HOST TELEMETRY surface. Found by running the real full suite: src/tests/hostTelemetry.test.ts failed with expected 107 to be less than or equal to 100. Root cause from reading the source: getHostCpuUsagePercent() probed os.cpuUsage, which is not a Node API (undefined on node v22.23.2), so that branch was dead and every reading came from the load-average proxy, which divided the 1-min load average by the core count WITHOUT clamping. Fixed: clamp to 100, dead branch removed, clampCpuPercent() exported. src/tests/hostTelemetry.test.ts now 8 tests / 8 passed. NEGATIVE-VALIDATED: replacing round(Math.min(v,100)) with round(v) makes the new assertion fail with 107 vs 100; restored after. The number is rendered live by HUDHeader.tsx, the Oracle Cloud modal and the spoken briefing, so an impossible 107% was being presented as measured. Gates OBSERVED on tip 00da222: npx vitest run 55 files / 772 tests passed, tsc --noEmit clean, build emitted dist/server.cjs (833708 bytes). Commits: 0096510 (fix+tests), 00da222 (docs+report). Rebase note: the remote advanced to 2c04ada while I worked (a concurrent slot android-bridge commit); fetched, rebased my fix on top, re-ran the targeted test, then pushed 2c04ada..0096510 and 0096510..00da222.
